fish.top: My son, God will provide
fish.bottom: himself a lamb for a burnt offering...

fish.top: In the beginning God created
fish.bottom: the heaven and the earth.

fish.top: And Enoch walked with God:
fish.bottom: and he was not; for God took him.

fish.top: I will not let thee go,
fish.bottom: except thou bless me.

fish.top: And, behold, I am with thee,
fish.bottom: and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest...

fish.top: And I am come down to deliver them
fish.bottom: out of the hand of the Egyptians...

fish.top: Ye thought evil against me;
fish.bottom: but God meant it unto good...

fish.top: The LORD is my strength and song,
fish.bottom: and he is become my salvation...

fish.top: My presence shall go with thee,
fish.bottom: and I will give thee rest.

fish.top: And he said,
fish.bottom: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

fish.top: For I am the LORD your God...
fish.bottom: ye shall be holy; for I am holy...

fish.top: For the life of the flesh is in the blood:
fish.bottom: ...it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

fish.top: The LORD bless thee,
fish.bottom: and keep thee.

fish.top: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land
fish.bottom: unto all the inhabitants thereof...

fish.top: ...every one that is bitten,
fish.bottom: when he looketh upon it, shall live.

fish.top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
fish.bottom: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...

fish.top: Be strong and of a good courage;
fish.bottom: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

fish.top: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve;
fish.bottom: ...as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

fish.top: ...and they shall be your refuge
fish.bottom: from the avenger of blood.

fish.top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
fish.bottom: but the LORD looketh on the heart.

fish.top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
fish.bottom: ...And he said, I will redeem it.

fish.top: Then Samuel answered,
fish.bottom: Speak; for thy servant heareth.

fish.top: And thine house and thy kingdom
fish.bottom: shall be established for ever before thee...

fish.top: ...for the battle is the LORD’s,
fish.bottom: and he will give you into our hands.

fish.top: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness
fish.bottom: ...and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

fish.top: Give therefore thy servant
fish.bottom: an understanding heart...

fish.top: ...There is not a vessel more.
fish.bottom: And the oil stayed.

fish.top: ...I pray thee, let a double portion
fish.bottom: of thy spirit be upon me.

fish.top: Then the fire of the LORD fell,
fish.bottom: and consumed the burnt sacrifice...

fish.top: ...and after the fire
fish.bottom: a still small voice.

fish.top: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears:
fish.bottom: behold, I will heal thee...

fish.top: I have found the book of the law
fish.bottom: in the house of the LORD.

fish.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good;
fish.bottom: for his mercy endureth for ever.

fish.top: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray,
fish.bottom: ...then will I hear from heaven... and will heal their land.

fish.top: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
fish.bottom: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

fish.top: ...neither be ye sorry;
fish.bottom: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

fish.top: The God of heaven, he will prosper us;
fish.bottom: therefore we his servants will arise and build...

fish.top: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom
fish.bottom: for such a time as this?

fish.top: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
fish.bottom: and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.

fish.top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
fish.bottom: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

fish.top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
fish.bottom: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

fish.top: The LORD is my shepherd;
fish.bottom: I shall not want.

fish.top: Be still, and know that I am God:
fish.bottom: I will be exalted among the heathen...

fish.top: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
fish.bottom: whom shall I fear?

fish.top: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
fish.bottom: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

fish.top: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
fish.bottom: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

fish.top: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee:
fish.bottom: my soul thirsteth for thee...

fish.top: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress:
fish.bottom: my God; in him will I trust.

fish.top: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
fish.bottom: shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

fish.top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
fish.bottom: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

fish.top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
fish.bottom: and into his courts with praise...

fish.top: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
fish.bottom: and a light unto my path.

fish.top: I will praise thee;
fish.bottom: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made...

fish.top: Let every thing that hath breath
fish.bottom: praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

fish.top: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
fish.bottom: and he shall direct thy paths.

fish.top: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
fish.bottom: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

fish.top: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
fish.bottom: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

fish.top: To every thing there is a season,
fish.bottom: and a time to every purpose under the heaven.

fish.top: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
fish.bottom: Then said I, Here am I; send me.

fish.top: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
fish.bottom: and shall call his name Immanuel.

fish.top: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:
fish.bottom: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow...

fish.top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
fish.bottom: whose mind is stayed on thee...

fish.top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
fish.bottom: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

fish.top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
fish.bottom: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...

fish.top: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people,
fish.bottom: saith your God.

fish.top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
fish.bottom: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

fish.top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
fish.bottom: ...and with his stripes we are healed.

fish.top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
fish.bottom: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

fish.top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
fish.bottom: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

fish.top: And ye shall seek me, and find me,
fish.bottom: when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

fish.top: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand,
fish.bottom: so are ye in mine hand...

fish.top: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth...
fish.bottom: ...there is nothing too hard for thee.

fish.top: ...his compassions fail not.
fish.bottom: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

fish.top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
fish.bottom: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

fish.top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...
fish.bottom: ...wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.

fish.top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
fish.bottom: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...

fish.top: And I sought for a man among them,
fish.bottom: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...

fish.top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
fish.bottom: and seek them out.

fish.top: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live:
fish.bottom: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish...

fish.top: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault;
fish.bottom: forasmuch as he was faithful...

fish.top: And I will restore to you
fish.bottom: the years that the locust hath eaten...

fish.top: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish
fish.bottom: to swallow up Jonah.

fish.top: ...I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh;
fish.bottom: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy...

fish.top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
fish.bottom: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

fish.top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
fish.bottom: that he may run that readeth it.

fish.top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
fish.bottom: he will rejoice over thee with joy...

fish.top: And he saith unto them, Follow me,
fish.bottom: and I will make you fishers of men.

fish.top: ...behold, thy King cometh unto thee:
fish.bottom: he is just, and having salvation; lowly...

fish.top: Give us this day
fish.bottom: our daily bread.

fish.top: Let your light so shine before men,
fish.bottom: that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father...

fish.top: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,
fish.bottom: baptizing them in the name of the Father...

fish.top: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed...
fish.bottom: ...nothing shall be impossible unto you.

fish.top: ...and upon this rock I will build my church;
fish.bottom: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

fish.top: Launch out into the deep,
fish.bottom: and let down your nets for a draught.

fish.top: For unto you is born this day in the city of David
fish.bottom: a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

fish.top: If thou canst believe,
fish.bottom: all things are possible to him that believeth.

fish.top: If the Son therefore shall make you free,
fish.bottom: ye shall be free indeed.

fish.top: For this my son was dead, and is alive again;
fish.bottom: he was lost, and is found.

fish.top: Verily, verily, I say unto thee,
fish.bottom: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

fish.top: ...whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him
fish.bottom: shall never thirst...

fish.top: Abide in me, and I in you.
fish.bottom: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine...

fish.top: ...he said, It is finished:
fish.bottom: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

fish.top: Cast the net on the right side of the ship,
fish.bottom: and ye shall find.

fish.top: I am the way, the truth, and the life:
fish.bottom: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

fish.top: But ye shall receive power,
fish.bottom: after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you...

fish.top: For the wages of sin is death;
fish.bottom: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

fish.top: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ,
fish.bottom: and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

fish.top: But where sin abounded,
fish.bottom: grace did much more abound.

fish.top: And be not conformed to this world:
fish.bottom: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind...

fish.top: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
fish.bottom: ...thou shalt be saved.

fish.top: And we know that all things work together for good
fish.bottom: to them that love God...

fish.top: My grace is sufficient for thee:
fish.bottom: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

fish.top: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory
fish.bottom: through our Lord Jesus Christ.

fish.top: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
fish.bottom: longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith...

fish.top: For by grace are ye saved through faith;
fish.bottom: and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.

fish.top: Rejoice in the Lord alway:
fish.bottom: and again I say, Rejoice.

fish.top: I press toward the mark for the prize
fish.bottom: of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

fish.top: Put on the whole armour of God,
fish.bottom: that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

fish.top: For the word of God is quick, and powerful,
fish.bottom: and sharper than any twoedged sword...

fish.top: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace,
fish.bottom: that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

fish.top: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course,
fish.bottom: I have kept the faith.

fish.top: ...and let us run with patience
fish.bottom: the race that is set before us.

fish.top: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for,
fish.bottom: the evidence of things not seen.

fish.top: Casting all your care upon him;
fish.bottom: for he careth for you.

fish.top: Surely I come quickly. Amen.
fish.bottom: Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

fish.top: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock:
fish.bottom: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in...

fish.top: And whosoever will,
fish.bottom: let him take the water of life freely.

fish.top: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain
fish.bottom: to receive power, and riches, and wisdom...
